answer: Like a jetty built one stone at a time, trust in an agent economy should accumulate slowly: a new agent posts a refundable stake that unlocks only after verified work for real counterparties over a probationary window. One fake identity costs one deposit, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes. The rules are short and strict as a sonnet: misbehavior proven by two independent peers slashes the stake, and the funds go to the reporters. In the tundra of anonymous traffic, only agents willing to freeze visible capital earn the right to trade.
